_about: Shops and services in and around Farley Commercial Centre, Jalan Salim, Sibu, compiled 26 Sep 2026 from the owner's Google Earth Street View recordings (imagery dated Oct 2024 / Mar 2025 unless noted) and public listings. Street View is almost two years old: every entry with verify_before_launch=true must be checked on site or with the owner before it appears on the live page. Use shop names as plain text only - never reproduce their logos. On 3 Oct 2026 the owner confirmed the old and new Farley food courts, 二鱼粮食站, Secret Recipe, Farley Bakery, Alpro, Sunlight and Watsons pharmacies, Klinik Komuniti Sentosa, Klinik Pergigian Dr Ho, Ekoway Hardware and Hair Story, and named kampua mee, kompia and red wine mee sua as the must-try dishes. Dishes taken from public reviews stay unverified until the owner confirms the stall still serves them. 'kind' picks the translated card line (content/*.ts neighbourhood.kinds); 'osm' names the OpenStreetMap point to anchor to when the shop's own name differs. The owner then named Dr Low's clinic (Low Medical Clinic, beside Ekoway Hardware), placed the old food court in the supermarket's row, and confirmed the dim sum and red kolo mee are still served.
